exposure: MRI-based radiomics features from HASTE and TRUFISP sequences
Clinical features (prior cesarean delivery, placenta previa, placental thickness)
cohort: 181 pregnant women suspected of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders who underwent MRI for placenta evaluation
finding: A combined model incorporating T2-weighted imaging MRI radiomics signatures and clinical features (prior cesarean delivery, placenta previa, and placental thickness) demonstrated the best discrimination ability for identifying invasive placentas in high-risk patients.
